description: This file defines interfaces, classes, enums, and constants related to Content Decryption Module (CDM) and Media Key Session management, including classes for BufferReader, IMediaKeySession, IMediaKeys, and related factory templates, primarily for handling encrypted media streams and DRM systems.

classes.name: BufferReader
classes.description: A class for reading various data types from a byte buffer, supporting multi-byte reads, string, and vector extraction, with internal position tracking.

classes.name: IMediaKeySessionCallback
classes.description: Interface for receiving events from a media key session, such as key messages, errors, and status updates.

classes.name: IMediaKeySession
classes.description: Interface representing a media key session, with methods for loading, updating, removing, closing, and decrypting media data.

classes.name: IMediaKeySessionExt
classes.description: Extended interface for media key sessions, including DRM header setting, challenge data handling, license storage, and key ID selection.

classes.name: IMediaKeys
classes.description: Interface for managing media keys, creating sessions, setting server certificates, and destroying sessions.

classes.name: IMediaKeysExt
classes.description: Extended interface for media keys, providing system time, version, secure stop management, and secure store operations.

classes.name: IMediaSystemMetrics
classes.description: Interface for retrieving media system metrics.

classes.name: IMediaSessionMetrics
classes.description: Interface for retrieving media session metrics.

classes.name: ISystemFactory
classes.description: Factory interface for creating media key system instances, with initialization and deinitialization methods.

classes.name: SystemFactoryType
classes.description: Template class implementing ISystemFactory for specific media key system implementations, with runtime type information and optional initialization/deinitialization.

methods.name: Instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of IMediaKeys.

methods.name: CreateMediaKeySession
methods.description: Creates a new media key session with specified key system and init data.

methods.name: SetServerCertificate
methods.description: Sets the server certificate for the media key system.

methods.name: DestroyMediaKeySession
methods.description: Destroys a specified media key session.

methods.name: GetMetadata
methods.description: Retrieves key system-specific metadata.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Starts the process of acquiring a key, with callback notifications.

methods.name: Load
methods.description: Loads session data into the CDM.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Processes a key message response.

methods.name: Remove
methods.description: Removes all licenses and keys associated with the session.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the media key session and releases resources.

methods.name: GetSessionId
methods.description: Returns the session ID.

methods.name: GetKeySystem
methods.description: Returns the key system identifier.

methods.name: SetDrmHeader
methods.description: Sets the DRM header data.

methods.name: GetChallengeDataExt
methods.description: Retrieves challenge data for license acquisition.

methods.name: CancelChallengeDataExt
methods.description: Cancels challenge data request.

methods.name: StoreLicenseData
methods.description: Stores license data and secure stop ID.

methods.name: SelectKeyId
methods.description: Selects a key ID for decryption.

methods.name: GetDrmSystemTime
methods.description: Retrieves the DRM system time.

methods.name: GetVersionExt
methods.description: Retrieves the version of the media key system.

methods.name: EnableSecureStop
methods.description: Enables or disables secure stop.

methods.name: ResetSecureStops
methods.description: Resets secure stops.

methods.name: GetSecureStopIds
methods.description: Retrieves secure stop IDs.

methods.name: GetSecureStop
methods.description: Retrieves secure stop data.

methods.name: CommitSecureStop
methods.description: Commits secure stop data.

methods.name: DeleteKeyStore
methods.description: Deletes the key store.

methods.name: DeleteSecureStore
methods.description: Deletes the secure store.

methods.name: GetKeyStoreHash
methods.description: Retrieves hash of the key store.

methods.name: GetSecureStoreHash
methods.description: Retrieves hash of the secure store.

methods.name: Metrics
methods.description: Retrieves media system or session metrics.

methods.name: GetSystemFactory
methods.description: Exports the factory function to get the media key system factory.
